items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: people like John Gilbert and Mary Pickford and Douglas Fairbanks.

ctx.x: That's beautiful, Teddy, and it's so nice to hear you say these things, because I think that's what young people really want to know about you -- how you feel about this business.

Because if they just separate, Milt -- like what is really good, like I remember, you know, when we started, the sound movie was just beginning, and they played things like Broadway Melody and those musicals, and people were talking with all those big stars whom people had never heard their voices, people like John Gilbert and Mary Pickford and Douglas Fairbanks.
